meta.provenance_note: Seven lessons per unit, transcribed 2026-09-10 from the student book itself. Each unit prints exactly seven «LESSON nA» page headers (1A..7A, 18pt), each carrying a skill banner and, after a «|», a topic label when the book gives one; and each lesson prints exactly one «□ I can …» statement, 35 per semester = 5 units × 7. Lesson identity and order come from those headers, and the «I can» statement is the lesson's outcome, held verbatim in objectives[]. Same Pearson «Jordan High Note» series and same format as the Grade 8 and Grade 9 English books, which this repo already models the same way. The two-page 'Contents' scope-and-sequence spread (PDF pages 4-5; columns UNIT, GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING, LISTENING, SPEAKING, WRITING) is still carried in the six *_topic / writing_task fields, with the book's own page references intact — but distributed onto the lesson whose printed pages each entry names. Arabic titles and topic labels are OUR OWN TRANSLATIONS: this book is English-only and prints no Arabic beyond its cover and its draft stamp. Only unit titles and skill banners are translated; topic labels and every «I can» outcome stay verbatim in English, because translating an outcome changes what a teacher is told the lesson delivers. Unit numbering continues the year: this book prints units 06-10, and those printed numbers are kept rather than renumbered from 1, the same convention the physics and chemistry semester-2 catalogs follow.

source_books.student_book_s2: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية الصف العاشر الفصل الثاني.pdf — 80 pages, sourceId eng-s2-student-book. Contents spread: pages 4-5.

known_gaps: THIS BOOK IS A DRAFT. 79 of its 80 pages carry the stamp «نسخة قيد الإعداد والتجهيز» (a copy under preparation); the semester-1 book carries it on none. Everything here is transcribed from that draft and may not match the final printed edition. Re-check this file against the final book when it is published. The stamp is only findable in extracted text as Arabic presentation forms, not as normal codepoints — a plain search for «قيد الإعداد» returns nothing.

Unit 6's vocabulary column disagrees with the book's own pages. The contents spread lists «p9 Relationships and caring for others», but printed page 9 is LESSON 4A GRAMMAR (the zero conditional) and the slot whose banner reads «LESSON 6A VOCABULARY | Relationships, caring for others» is printed on page 11. The banner decides, so that entry is filed on LESSON 6A; its page reference is kept exactly as the contents spread prints it rather than silently corrected. Consistent with this book being a draft (see the first gap above). Every other scope-and-sequence entry in both semesters lands on a lesson whose printed pages it names.

No نتاجات التعلم boxes. This series prints none of the Arabic learning-outcome lists the science student books carry; what it prints instead is one «□ I can …» statement per lesson, and that is what objectives[] holds. So the outcomes here are the book's own words, not invented — but they are not NCCD نتاجات and should not be read as such.
No period counts — the English teacher's guide is not in the repo.

vocabulary[] is empty everywhere. This book scatters its words through the lesson exercises and the Word List on pp64-68 rather than printing a terms box on the lesson opener — the same gap recorded in the Grade 8 and Grade 9 English files.

The LIFE SKILLS spreads (after units 6, 8 and 10) print no «LESSON nA» header and no «I can», so they are not lessons. Each is kept in the life_skill field of the last lesson of the unit it follows — the lesson it is printed immediately after — so that its title and pages stay in the catalog rather than being dropped; it is not a claim that the spread belongs to that lesson. The third of them, «How to identify fake news» pp58-59 after unit 10, was missing from this file entirely before 2026-09-10 and is now recorded the same way as the other two. The end matter — Culture Spot pp60-61, Literature Spot pp62-63, Word List pp64-68, Grammar Reference pp69-73, Irregular Verbs p74, Communication pp75-76 — is not modelled at all.
The book photographs in knowledge-base/figure-lesson-map.json are still filed at UNIT granularity, on each unit's lesson 1 — see the matching gap in the semester-1 file.
